title: What makes a composite solid?
narration: A composite solid combines familiar three-dimensional pieces. The first question is whether pieces are added, overlapping, or removed.
math: Volume of whole = sum of non-overlapping parts − removed parts.

title: Volume and surface area
narration: Volume counts space inside, in cubic units. Surface area covers only the outside, in square units. Shared interior faces do not count.

title: Label the shapes
narration: Separate the object into boxes, prisms, cylinders, cones, pyramids, and hemispheres. Mark every radius and perpendicular height.
math: Prism: V = B h; cylinder: V = π r² h.

title: The formulas
narration: For a cone or pyramid take one-third of the matching prism or cylinder. A hemisphere is half a sphere.

title: Worked example: two blocks
narration: A 6 by 4 by 2 block supports a 2 by 4 by 3 block. Add the two volumes because they touch but do not overlap.

title: Worked example: curved roof
narration: A cylinder of radius three and height four supports a cone of radius three and height six. Compute each separately.

title: Worked example: tunnel
narration: A rectangular opening is removed from an eight by five by three block. Subtract the tunnel's volume.

title: Worked example: hemisphere
narration: A hemisphere of radius three caps a cylinder of radius three and height five. Use the half-sphere formula.

title: Exposed surface area
narration: Two cubes of side three are glued along a square face. The two contact faces are internal and must be removed from the sum of surface areas.

title: Avoid traps
narration: Radius is half the diameter. Never double-count an overlap. Subtract a hole. Keep π exact when requested and check units.

title: Exam method
narration: Create a signed list of parts, calculate each volume, and combine. For a missing dimension, subtract the known volume first, then solve the remaining formula.

title: Recap and next step
narration: You can now add solid volumes, subtract voids, and remove hidden faces for exterior area. Practice eighteen questions and take the five-question test.
